title: fix(sdui-parser): containment reads the declared children input, not isContainer; lockstep pins the predicate
body:
Fixes #19969

Clause-②: no

## What this does

The save gate's `validateTree` in `packages/sdui-parser` now decides `not-a-container` by the component's declared `children` input. It no longer reads `isContainer`, and there is no fallback to the flag. This is the byte-equal port of objectui `5ea623ea` (objectui#9910 Q1-A, re-cut as objectui PR #10270), which is already inside the console pin `f8a9d0fb0596` (PR #20036). The objectui side it mirrors is `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts` at the pin: `CHILD_LIST_KEY` at `:33`, `acceptsChildren` at `:57-59` and the containment branch at `:220`.

- **Predicate semantics mirrored exactly.** The test is `comp.inputs.some((input) => input.name === CHILD_LIST_KEY)`. It matches on the **name** `children` alone, whatever the input's coarse type. The dispatch brief said "name `children`, type `slot`". objectui deliberately matches on the name only, because the five page kinds publish `children` typed `array`, and objectui pins that case. This port follows objectui, not the brief.
- **A component the manifest has no entry for** draws `unknown-component` and gets no containment verdict. This is unchanged and is the same on both sides.
- **`isContainer`** stays on `ManifestComponent`, re-described as layout containment in the same words objectui uses. `index.ts` is unchanged: no new public export. objectui exported `acceptsChildren` and `CHILD_LIST_KEY` from its entry for its own census tests, and nothing here needs that.

## The lockstep pin (maintainer-named in the ruling)

`scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` now also compares the **containment predicate**. The gate extracts the condition of the one `if` in `validate.ts` whose body stamps `not-a-container`. It adds the module-level declarations that condition reaches, transitively (`acceptsChildren`, then `CHILD_LIST_KEY`), and reduces the result to its token sequence. Comments and wrapping do not change the reading. A changed token does. The gate compares this reading against a new `containmentPredicate` field in the vendored objectui record.

- The record was regenerated with `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` against an objectui checkout parked on the pin `f8a9d0fb0596`. Every other field of the record is byte-unchanged; the only diff is the new `containmentPredicate` block.
- If `validate.ts` has zero or two containment branches, the gate refuses (`[containment-unreachable]`). It never measures only one of two.
- A new self-test battery with 10 cases is added, and the battery floor goes from 6 to 7. The first case asserts that the flag predicate and the slot predicate read differently.

## The five served components (tracked `sdui.manifest.json` at `0bf85eaa`, 5 of 59 disagree)

| component | `isContainer` | declares `children` | before (flag) | after (declared input) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `badge` | false | yes (`slot`) | warns `not-a-container` (false) | no warning |
| `alert` | false | yes (`slot`) | warns (false) | no warning |
| `button` | false | yes (`slot`) | warns (false) | no warning |
| `page:tabs` | true | no | silent | warns `not-a-container` |
| `page:accordion` | true | no | silent | warns `not-a-container` |

The new `containment-declared-slot.test.ts` uses these five entries, copied verbatim from the manifest. Each gets its own case, plus a control asserting that the two predicates really disagree on every one. The file also carries objectui's 2×2 (flag × slot) reading.

## Ablation (a trap restores the file, and the restore is proven byte-identical to HEAD by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

- **Leg 1: revert the port.** The branch was changed back to `!comp.isContainer` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `819b7b6a83ac` to `670ce98bdb15`. `node scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` exited **1** with `[containment-drift]`, printing both texts. The file was then restored to blob `819b7b6a83ac` = HEAD.
- **Leg 2: sneak the fallback into the helper.** The mutation appended an `isContainer` fallback to the `acceptsChildren` return. The gate exited **1** with `[containment-drift]`. Restored to `819b7b6a83ac`.
- **Test-suite leg (same mutation as leg 1).** The new test file went **8 failed / 5 passed** (exit 1). Restored.
- **Restore leg.** `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` on HEAD `f3ff1e6e9` exits **0**: the self-test passes, and the gate reports agreement on all 26 codes and on the `not-a-container` predicate (blob `76c18fb95d1f`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/sdui-parser typecheck`: exit 0. `--listFiles` includes the new test.
- `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 81 commands. `--ran` reconciles: 77 exit 0, 4 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
  - NOT MEASURED, prerequisite unmet: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt` each exited 3 because they need a full workspace build.
  - NOT MEASURED, over the time cap: `check:pm-dispatch-gates`. Its self-test ran past the foreground cap, was killed twice, and is declared to CI.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 because this is a shallow checkout. It exited 0 after fetching its pinned fixture commit.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 6 touched source files: 0 errors, 0 warnings. This is a targeted run, not a proven narrowing, so the full `pnpm lint` is declared to CI.

## packages/lint fixture: resolved by PM ruling `5825043664`

The PM ruling on #19969 (comment `5825043664`, Q2 = A) widened this card file surface by exactly one test fixture. Commit `bfb082b0b` gives the hand-made `flex` entry at `packages/lint/src/validate-jsx-pages.test.ts:39` the `children` input, the same triage objectui made on its own fixtures:

```ts
flex: { type: flex, namespace: ui, isContainer: true, inputs: [{ name: children, type: slot }] },
```

No other `packages/lint` file changes; `authoring-rules.ts` and the lint caller are untouched. Q1 = A, provisionally: the changeset stays `patch` with `Clause-②: no`, and the contract review judges it on the final head.

On head `bfb082b0b`, after rebuilding the `@objectstack/lint` dependency closure:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run`: 108 of 108 files passed; 4133 tests passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed (VERDICT command-exit 0). Before this commit it was 1 failed / 4132 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0.
- sdui-parser suite: 189 of 189 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/sdui-parser typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on the 9-path set derived 82 commands (one new: `check:docs-transcript-drift`, exit 0 after building `@objectstack/lint`). `--ran` reconciles: 78 exit 0, 4 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. The four are `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt` (each exit 3, prerequisite: a full workspace build) and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (over the foreground cap). All four are declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- `codegen.ts`'s `generateBlockList` still labels its column "container" from `isContainer`. Under Q2-A that column now means layout container. It is unchanged here, and objectui leaves it as-is too.
